lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in parallel horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, showing increased spatial separation as they progress towards the posterior.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal spot rows to form a defined grid-like lattice across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by sharp vertical gradients with high-intensity highlights on the dorsal edges and shadowed troughs on the ventral edges.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A moderate density of high-luminance blobs is visible within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, primarily distributed across the lower and middle regions of the fin surface.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple slender, high-luminance biological features consistent with commensal organisms (remoras) clustered near the ventral pectoral region and along the belly.
